title: Simple Registration Form
prompt: Build a small registration form with a labeled name field, labeled email field, and a submit button.
objective: Use explicit labels, type=email, required, name, and a submit button.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: labels, text fields, email, radio buttons.
hints: Match each label for value to the corresponding input id. Give the inputs names for submitted data.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer: Create an Account
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: Match each label for value to the corresponding input id. Give the inputs names for submitted data. Required structural evidence: <form, <label, type="email", name=, <button.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: labels, text fields, email, radio buttons.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
